messages:
Sam Nguyen: Running the quickstart and getting blocked on the very first API call.
I set REDWOOD_API_KEY and followed README but curl returns 402. Anyone know why? @Maria Ortiz

Sam Nguyen: Command I ran:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1","input":"hello"}'
```

Sam Nguyen: Response body:
```json
{"error":{"code":"billing_required","message":"Workspace needs billing setup before usage"}}
```

Maria Ortiz: Hmm — 402 is our billing-gated response. Did you accept the workspace invite and attach a payment method? We give free credits but the org must have billing enabled for usage beyond signup flow.

Sam Nguyen: I accepted the invite, but the Console still shows an "Enable billing" button. The quickstart README doesn't call that out.

Leah Kaplan: Support here — can you DM me your org id and the signup email? We have an internal promo override we can apply if the invite email matches.

Aj Patel: Backend note — gating is intentional to prevent abuse. We do have a promo override endpoint but it requires an exact email match + internal flag. I'll look up the organization in logs when Sam shares the ID.

Sam Nguyen: DM sent with org id org_01G7XXXXX and the signup email. Also small DX note: README shows REDWOOD_API_KEY but doesn't show where to find it in the Console; tripped up a few folks in my team.

Maria Ortiz: Good catch. I'll update the quickstart to include: Console > Settings > API keys > Create key, and mention that workspace billing must be enabled for production calls. Also filing a tiny DX bug to clarify HTTP error codes (402 vs 403 vs 401).

Maria Ortiz: Filed issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex/issues/812 — short-term proposal: add a "use sandbox credits" CLI flag and a UI tooltip on the Console billing CTA.

Aj Patel: Promo flag applied for org_01G7XXXXX. Should take ~2 minutes to propagate. If you still see 402 after that, post the error body here.

devex-bot: Promo applied for org_01G7XXXXX by Aj Patel. Expires in 7 days.

Sam Nguyen: Retried just now — 200 OK, first successful call! :tada: Thanks everyone.

Sam Nguyen: Two tiny follow-ups: 1) sample app should show exact Console path to API keys; 2) note the difference between workspace token and org billing owner. Saved someone else an hour.

Maria Ortiz: Thanks — I'll open a PR to the sample app and add the onboarding note.

Leah Kaplan: Support ticket #3249 updated and closed after confirmation.

Sam Nguyen: Appreciate the quick help!
